json_schema.description: A notification hit the re-delivery cap without ever being delivered, and will not be attempted again. Existence-based quarantine, mirroring goal_stuck: the presence of this event is what stops the retries, as opposed to an escalation event that coexists with continued attempts and would look like a fix while costing the same. The owner_notify contract stays OPEN on purpose — the result really is still unobserved, and closing it here would hide exactly the thing an operator needs to see.
